# Setup

```{python}
# | label: load-packages

import pprint
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objs as go
from scipy.stats import gaussian_kde

from inf_bp_texts.inference import fit_birth_death_processes
from inf_bp_texts.simulation import simulate_birth_death_process
from inf_bp_texts.visualization import save_figure
from joblib import Parallel, delayed

# Import professional styling configuration from central plotting module
from inf_bp_texts.visualization.plotting import (
    apply_professional_styling,
    apply_tufte_axes,
    font_config,
    title_font_config,
    plot_bgcolor,
    paper_bgcolor,
    gridcolor,
    my_blue,
    my_cyan,
    my_green,
    my_yellow,
    my_red,
    my_violet,
    my_gray,
    ptolqual,
)

color_palette = ptolqual

# Create directory for saving figures
figures_dir = Path("figures")
figures_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
```

## Simulate Manuscript Transmission

```{python}
# | label: simulate-processes


num_sims = 1000
birth_rate = 0.005
death_rate = birth_rate - 0.004
time_span = 1500.0
seed = 42

print(f"🎲 Generate {num_sims} birth-and-death process simulations...")
print(f"   Birth rate: {birth_rate}")
print(f"   Death rate: {death_rate}")
print(f"   Time span: {time_span} years")
print("=" * 60)

# Run simulations in parallel using all available CPU cores
simulated_processes = Parallel(n_jobs=-1)(
    delayed(simulate_birth_death_process)(
        birth_rate=birth_rate,
        death_rate=death_rate,
        max_time=time_span,
        random_seed=seed + i,
    )
    for i in range(num_sims)
)

print(f"\n✅ Completed {len(simulated_processes)} simulations")
```

### Sort Simulations

```{python}
# | label: get-ages

list_of_ages = []
num_of_deaths = np.empty(num_sims)
num_of_births = np.empty(num_sims)
cumulative_lifetimes = np.empty(num_sims)


for i, sim in enumerate(simulated_processes):
    is_alive_man = sim["death_time"].isna()
    alive_mans = sim[is_alive_man]
    alive_mans = alive_mans.sort_values("is_spine", ascending=False)
    ages = time_span - alive_mans["creation_time"].values
    list_of_ages.append((ages))
    num_of_births[i] = len(sim) - 1
    num_of_deaths[i] = sum(sim["death_time"].notna())
    cumulative_lifetimes[i] = (
        sim["death_time"].fillna(time_span).values - sim["creation_time"]
    ).sum()
```

### Print Example Simulation

```{python}
# | label: print-example-simulation

print("First simulation:\n")
print(simulated_processes[0].head(5))
print(simulated_processes[0].tail(5))
print("Sample ages\n")
print(list_of_ages[0][0:10])

```

# Model Inference

## Fit All Models Using Ages

```{python}
# | eval: true
# | label: fit-individual-models
print("=" * 60)


# Define a function to fit a single model
def fit_single_model(ages, time_span):
    """Fit a single birth-and-death model to given ages."""
    if len(ages) == 0:
        return None
    try:
        model = fit_birth_death_processes(
            list_of_ages=[ages],
            times=time_span,
            is_ordered=True,
        )
        return model
    except Exception as e:
        return None


# Fit models in parallel
fitted_models = Parallel(n_jobs=-1)(
    delayed(fit_single_model)(ages, time_span) for ages in list_of_ages
)

# Count successes and failures
successful_fits = sum(
    1 for m in fitted_models if m is not None and m.get("success", False)
)
failed_fits = len(fitted_models) - successful_fits

print(f"   Total models: {len(simulated_processes)}")
print(f"   Successful fits: {successful_fits}")
print(f"   Failed fits: {failed_fits}")
print(f"   Success rate: {(successful_fits / len(simulated_processes) * 100):.1f}%")
```

### Profile Single Fit

```{python}
# | eval: true
# | label: profile-single-fit
%%prun -s cumulative -q -l 30 -T prof-single-fit


print("🔍 Profiling a single model fit...")

for ages in list_of_ages[0:min(len(list_of_ages), 50)]:
    fit_single_model(ages, time_span)

print(f"Result: {result}")
```

## Summary Statistics

```{python}
# | label: summary-statistics

print("📊 Compute summary statistics...")

# Collect birth and death rates from fitted models
birth_rates = [
    m["birth_rate"] for m in fitted_models if m is not None and m.get("success", False)
]
death_rates = [
    m["death_rate"] for m in fitted_models if m is not None and m.get("success", False)
]

print(
    f"   Successfully extracted {len(birth_rates)} birth rates and {len(death_rates)} death rates"
)

summary_stats = {
    "Parameter": ["Birth Rate", "Death Rate"],
    "True Value": [birth_rate, death_rate],
    "Mean": [np.mean(birth_rates), np.mean(death_rates)],
    "Median": [np.median(birth_rates), np.median(death_rates)],
    "Std": [np.std(birth_rates), np.std(death_rates)],
    "Min": [np.min(birth_rates), np.min(death_rates)],
    "Max": [np.max(birth_rates), np.max(death_rates)],
    "25%": [np.percentile(birth_rates, 25), np.percentile(death_rates, 25)],
    "75%": [np.percentile(birth_rates, 75), np.percentile(death_rates, 75)],
}

stats_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_stats)
print("\n📈 Parameter Estimation Summary:")
print("=" * 60)
print(stats_df.to_string(index=False, float_format="%.6f"))
```

## Plots for Age-Based Inference

```{python}
# | label: plot-bd-inference

if len(birth_rates) > 1:
    birth_kde = gaussian_kde(birth_rates)
    x_birth = np.linspace(
        min(birth_rates), min([max(birth_rates), 10 * birth_rate]), 100
    )
    fig_birth = go.Figure()
    fig_birth.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=x_birth,
            y=birth_kde(x_birth),
            mode="lines",
            name="Density",
            line=dict(color=ptolqual[0]),
            showlegend=False,
        )
    )
    # Add vertical line for true birth_rate
    fig_birth.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[birth_rate, birth_rate],
            y=[0, max(birth_kde(x_birth))],
            mode="lines",
            name="λ",
            line=dict(color=ptolqual[1], dash="dash"),
            showlegend=False,
        )
    )
    # Add annotation for λ above the density curve
    fig_birth.add_annotation(
        x=birth_rate,  # point annotation above the true-rate line
        y=max(birth_kde(x_birth)) * 1.05,  # place slightly above the density peak
        text="True λ",
        showarrow=True,
        arrowhead=2,
        ax=0,
        ay=-30,  # draw arrow from label down to the line
        xanchor="center",
        font=dict(color=ptolqual[1], size=11),
        bgcolor="rgba(255,255,255,0.75)",
    )
    # Place a small, unobtrusive legend inside the plot
    fig_birth.update_layout(showlegend=False)
    fig_birth = apply_professional_styling(
        fig_birth, None, r"$\hat{\lambda}$", "Density"
    )
    fig_birth = apply_tufte_axes(fig_birth)
    # Format axes: rate with 4 decimals, density baseline at zero
    fig_birth.update_xaxes(tickformat=".4f")
    fig_birth.update_yaxes(rangemode="tozero")
    fig_birth.show()

    # Save the figure
    save_figure(fig_birth, "mv_birth_rate_density_marg", width=192, height=110)
    save_figure(fig_birth, "mv_birth_rate_density", width=397, height=200)
else:
    print("   ⚠️  Not enough fitted models to plot birth rate density.")

if len(death_rates) > 1:
    death_kde = gaussian_kde(death_rates)
    x_death = np.linspace(
        min(death_rates), min([max(death_rates), 10 * death_rate]), 100
    )
    fig_death = go.Figure()
    fig_death.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=x_death,
            y=death_kde(x_death),
            mode="lines",
            name="Density",
            line=dict(color=ptolqual[0]),
            showlegend=False,
        )
    )
    # Add vertical line for true death_rate
    fig_death.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[death_rate, death_rate],
            y=[0, max(death_kde(x_death))],
            mode="lines",
            name="μ",
            line=dict(color=ptolqual[1], dash="dash"),
            showlegend=False,
        )
    )
    # Add annotation for μ to the above of the density curve
    fig_death.add_annotation(
        x=death_rate,  # Position to the right of the line
        y=max(death_kde(x_death)) * 1.05,  # Near the top of the density
        text="True μ",
        showarrow=True,
        arrowhead=2,
        ax=0,
        ay=-30,  # draw arrow from label down to the line
        xanchor="center",
        font=dict(color=ptolqual[1], size=11),
        bgcolor="rgba(255,255,255,0.75)",
    )
    fig_death = apply_professional_styling(fig_death, None, r"$\hat{\mu}$", "Density")
    fig_death = apply_tufte_axes(fig_death)
    # Format axes: rate with 4 decimals, density baseline at zero
    fig_death.update_xaxes(tickformat=".4f")
    fig_death.update_yaxes(rangemode="tozero")
    fig_death.update_layout(showlegend=False)
    fig_death.show()

    # Save the figure
    save_figure(fig_death, "mv_death_rate_density_marg", width=192, height=100)
    save_figure(fig_death, "mv_death_rate_density", width=397, height=200)
else:
```

```{python}
# | label: joint-density-plot

print("\n🎯 Create 2D joint density plot...")

if len(birth_rates) > 1 and len(death_rates) > 1:
    xy = np.vstack([birth_rates, death_rates])
    kde = gaussian_kde(xy)
    x_grid = np.linspace(min(birth_rates), 2 * birth_rate, 100)
    y_grid = np.linspace(min(death_rates), 3 * death_rate, 100)
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(x_grid, y_grid)
    positions = np.vstack([X.ravel(), Y.ravel()])
    Z = kde(positions).reshape(X.shape)
    fig_joint = go.Figure(
        data=go.Contour(
            x=x_grid,
            y=y_grid,
            z=Z,
            colorscale="Viridis",
            contours=dict(showlabels=True),
            colorbar=dict(title="Density"),
        )
    )
    fig_joint.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[birth_rate],
            y=[death_rate],
            mode="markers",
            marker=dict(color=ptolqual[1], size=8, symbol="circle"),
            name="True Value",
        )
    )
    fig_joint = apply_professional_styling(
        fig_joint,
        None,
        "Birth Rate",
        "Death Rate",
    )
    fig_joint = apply_tufte_axes(fig_joint)
    # Format axes for rates
    fig_joint.update_xaxes(tickformat=".4f")
    fig_joint.update_yaxes(tickformat=".4f")
    try:
        from inf_bp_texts.visualization.plotting import apply_tufte_legend

        fig_joint = apply_tufte_legend(fig_joint, position="top right")
    except Exception:
        fig_joint.update_layout(showlegend=True)
    fig_joint.show()

    # Save the figure
    save_figure(fig_joint, "mv_joint_density_rates_marg", width=192, height=150)
    save_figure(fig_joint, "mv_joint_density_rates", width=397, height=250)
else:
    print("   ⚠️  Not enough fitted models for joint density plot.")
```

```{python}
# | label: box-plots

import plotly.graph_objs as go

# Prepare data for box plot
box_data = [
    birth_rates,
    death_rates,
]

labels = ["MLE Birth Rates", "MLE Death Rates"]
true_values = [birth_rate, death_rate]
means = [np.mean(birth_rates), np.mean(death_rates)]
medians = [np.median(birth_rates), np.median(death_rates)]

# Create summary table
mse_birth = np.mean((np.array(birth_rates) - birth_rate) ** 2)
mse_death = np.mean((np.array(death_rates) - death_rate) ** 2)

box_summary = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Parameter": ["Birth Rate (λ)", "Death Rate (μ)"],
        "True Value": true_values,
        "Mean": means,
        "Median": medians,
        "Std Dev": [np.std(birth_rates), np.std(death_rates)],
        "Q1 (25%)": [np.percentile(birth_rates, 25), np.percentile(death_rates, 25)],
        "Q3 (75%)": [np.percentile(birth_rates, 75), np.percentile(death_rates, 75)],
        "Min": [np.min(birth_rates), np.min(death_rates)],
        "Max": [np.max(birth_rates), np.max(death_rates)],
        "Bias": [np.mean(birth_rates) - birth_rate, np.mean(death_rates) - death_rate],
        "Rel. Bias (%)": [
            (np.mean(birth_rates) - birth_rate) / birth_rate * 100,
            (np.mean(death_rates) - death_rate) / death_rate * 100,
        ],
        "MSE": [mse_birth, mse_death],
        "RMSE": [np.sqrt(mse_birth), np.sqrt(mse_death)],
    }
)

print("\n📊 Parameter Estimation Box Plot Summary:")
print("=" * 80)
print(box_summary.to_string(index=False, float_format="%.6f"))

fig_box = go.Figure()

for i, data in enumerate(box_data):
    fig_box.add_trace(
        go.Box(
            y=data,
            name=labels[i],
            boxmean=True,
            boxpoints="outliers",
            marker_color=ptolqual[0],
        )
    )
    # Add true value
    fig_box.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[labels[i]],
            y=[true_values[i]],
            mode="markers",
            marker=dict(color=ptolqual[1], size=8, symbol="circle"),
            name="True",
            showlegend=(i == 0),
        )
    )
    # Add sample mean
    fig_box.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[labels[i]],
            y=[means[i]],
            mode="markers",
            marker=dict(color=ptolqual[2], size=10, symbol="circle"),
            name="Mean",
            showlegend=(i == 0),
        )
    )
    # Add sample median
    fig_box.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[labels[i]],
            y=[medians[i]],
            mode="markers",
            marker=dict(color=ptolqual[3], size=10, symbol="square"),
            name="Median",
            showlegend=(i == 0),
        )
    )

fig_box = apply_professional_styling(
    fig_box, "Box Plot of Fitted Birth and Death Rates", "Parameter", "Rate"
)
fig_box = apply_tufte_axes(fig_box)
fig_box.update_yaxes(tickformat=".4f", rangemode="tozero")
# Override showlegend for box plot
try:
    from inf_bp_texts.visualization.plotting import apply_tufte_legend

    fig_box = apply_tufte_legend(fig_box, position="top right")
except Exception:
    fig_box.update_layout(showlegend=True)
fig_box.show()

# Save the figure
save_figure(fig_box, "mv_parameter_boxplots", width=397, height=250)
```

```{python}
# | label: cumulative-mult-proc
# | eval: false
cumulative_estimates = []
has_age = False

for i in [0, 1, int(num_sims / 8), int(num_sims / 4), int(num_sims / 2), int(num_sims)]:
    if not has_age:
        if len(list_of_ages[i]) > 1:
            has_age = True
    if has_age:
        model = fit_birth_death_processes(
            list_of_ages=list_of_ages[0 : (i + 1)],
            times=time_span,
            is_ordered=True,
        )
        # model may be None, a dict, or an OptimizeResult-like object with attribute `x`.
        if model is None:
            cumulative_estimates.append(None)
        else:
            if hasattr(model, "x"):
                cumulative_estimates.append(model.x)
            elif isinstance(model, dict) and "x" in model:
                cumulative_estimates.append(model["x"])
            else:
                # Fallback: store the whole model object/dict
                cumulative_estimates.append(model)
    else:
        cumulative_estimates.append(None)

print(cumulative_estimates)
```

# Parameter Sensitivity Analysis

Compare inference performance across different death rate values while keeping birth rate, time span, and number of simulations constant.

```{python}
# | label: parameter-sensitivity-setup

print("=" * 60)
print("🔬 PARAMETER SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 60)

# Define parameter configurations
base_birth_rate = 0.005
base_time_span = 1500
base_num_sims = 1000
death_rate_values = [0.001, 0.0025, 0.005]

parameter_configs = [
    {
        "birth_rate": base_birth_rate,
        "death_rate": dr,
        "time_span": base_time_span,
        "num_sims": base_num_sims,
    }
    for dr in death_rate_values
]

print(f"\n📊 Testing {len(parameter_configs)} parameter configurations:")
for i, config in enumerate(parameter_configs, 1):
    print(
        f"   Config {i}: λ={config['birth_rate']}, μ={config['death_rate']}, T={config['time_span']}, n={config['num_sims']}"
    )
print("=" * 60)
```

## Run Simulations for Each Configuration

```{python}
# | label: sensitivity-simulations

all_results = []

for config_idx, config in enumerate(parameter_configs):
    print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
    print(f"🎲 Configuration {config_idx + 1}/{len(parameter_configs)}")
    print(f"   Birth rate (λ): {config['birth_rate']}")
    print(f"   Death rate (μ): {config['death_rate']}")
    print(f"   Time span (T): {config['time_span']}")
    print(f"   Simulations (n): {config['num_sims']}")
    print(f"{'=' * 60}")

    # Run simulations
    simulated_processes_config = Parallel(n_jobs=-1)(
        delayed(simulate_birth_death_process)(
            birth_rate=config["birth_rate"],
            death_rate=config["death_rate"],
            max_time=config["time_span"],
            random_seed=seed + i + config_idx * 10000,
        )
        for i in range(config["num_sims"])
    )

    # Extract ages
    list_of_ages_config = []
    for sim in simulated_processes_config:
        is_alive_man = sim["death_time"].isna()
        alive_mans = sim[is_alive_man]
        alive_mans = alive_mans.sort_values("is_spine", ascending=False)
        ages = config["time_span"] - alive_mans["creation_time"].values
        list_of_ages_config.append(ages)

    # Fit models
    fitted_models_config = Parallel(n_jobs=-1)(
        delayed(fit_single_model)(ages, config["time_span"])
        for ages in list_of_ages_config
    )

    # Collect results
    successful_fits = [
        m for m in fitted_models_config if m is not None and m.get("success", False)
    ]
    birth_rates_config = [m["birth_rate"] for m in successful_fits]
    death_rates_config = [m["death_rate"] for m in successful_fits]

    # Calculate statistics
    if len(birth_rates_config) > 0:
        birth_mean = np.mean(birth_rates_config)
        birth_std = np.std(birth_rates_config)
        birth_bias = birth_mean - config["birth_rate"]
        birth_rel_bias = birth_bias / config["birth_rate"] * 100
        birth_mse = np.mean((np.array(birth_rates_config) - config["birth_rate"]) ** 2)
        birth_rmse = np.sqrt(birth_mse)
    else:
        birth_mean = birth_std = birth_bias = birth_rel_bias = birth_mse = (
            birth_rmse
        ) = np.nan

    if len(death_rates_config) > 0:
        death_mean = np.mean(death_rates_config)
        death_std = np.std(death_rates_config)
        death_bias = death_mean - config["death_rate"]
        death_rel_bias = death_bias / config["death_rate"] * 100
        death_mse = np.mean((np.array(death_rates_config) - config["death_rate"]) ** 2)
        death_rmse = np.sqrt(death_mse)
    else:
        death_mean = death_std = death_bias = death_rel_bias = death_mse = (
            death_rmse
        ) = np.nan

    result = {
        "config_idx": config_idx + 1,
        "birth_rate_true": config["birth_rate"],
        "death_rate_true": config["death_rate"],
        "time_span": config["time_span"],
        "num_sims": config["num_sims"],
        "num_successful": len(successful_fits),
        "success_rate": len(successful_fits) / config["num_sims"] * 100,
        "birth_rates": birth_rates_config,
        "death_rates": death_rates_config,
        "birth_mean": birth_mean,
        "birth_std": birth_std,
        "birth_bias": birth_bias,
        "birth_rel_bias": birth_rel_bias,
        "birth_rmse": birth_rmse,
        "death_mean": death_mean,
        "death_std": death_std,
        "death_bias": death_bias,
        "death_rel_bias": death_rel_bias,
        "death_rmse": death_rmse,
    }

    all_results.append(result)

    print(
        f"   ✅ Successful fits: {len(successful_fits)}/{config['num_sims']} ({result['success_rate']:.1f}%)"
    )
    print(
        f"   λ̂: {birth_mean:.6f} ± {birth_std:.6f} (true: {config['birth_rate']:.6f})"
    )
    print(
        f"   μ̂: {death_mean:.6f} ± {death_std:.6f} (true: {config['death_rate']:.6f})"
    )
```

The age distribution for a BD process with one epoch when there is a no more birth:

$$
\frac{\left(\lambda  e^{(\lambda -\mu ) (T-l)}-\mu \right) e^{\lambda  l-l \mu +\lambda  M-\mu  M-\lambda  T} \left(\mu  e^{\mu  (l+M)+\lambda  T}-\lambda  e^{\lambda  l+\lambda  M+\mu  T}\right)}{\left(\lambda  e^{M (\lambda -\mu )}-\mu \right) \left(\lambda  e^{\lambda  (l+M)}-\lambda  e^{\mu  (l+M)+T (\lambda -\mu )}+\lambda  e^{l \mu +\lambda  T}-\mu  e^{l \mu +\lambda  T}\right)}
$$

# Optimization Method Benchmarking

Compare different optimization methods and gradient computation approaches to determine the most efficient fitting strategy.

## Setup for Benchmarking

```{python}
# | label: benchmark-setup

import time
from scipy import optimize
from typing import Callable
import warnings

from inf_bp_texts.inference.likelihood import (
    negative_log_likelihood,
    log_likelihood_gradient,
)

# Generate test data for benchmarking
np.random.seed(42)
benchmark_ages = np.random.exponential(scale=200, size=100)
benchmark_time = 1000.0
benchmark_initial_params = (0.01, 0.02)
benchmark_log_initial = np.log(benchmark_initial_params)

print(f"\n📊 Benchmark Configuration:")
print(f"   Number of ages: {len(benchmark_ages)}")
print(f"   Observation time: {benchmark_time}")
print(
    f"   Initial parameters: λ={benchmark_initial_params[0]:.6f}, μ={benchmark_initial_params[1]:.6f}"
)
print(
    f"   Initial log-parameters: log(λ)={benchmark_log_initial[0]:.6f}, log(μ)={benchmark_log_initial[1]:.6f}"
)
print(f"   Parameter bounds: [{np.exp(np.log(1e-8)):.2e}, {np.exp(np.log(100.0)):.2e}]")
print("=" * 60)
```

## Define Optimization Strategies

```{python}
# | label: define-strategies

# Parameter bounds in log space
log_bounds = [
    (np.log(1e-8), np.log(100.0)),  # log(birth_rate)
    (np.log(1e-8), np.log(100.0)),  # log(death_rate)
]


def objective_analytical(log_params: np.ndarray) -> float:
    """Objective function using analytical gradient."""
    params = np.exp(log_params)
    return negative_log_likelihood(
        params=params,
        ages=benchmark_ages,
        observation_time=benchmark_time,
        spine_ages=None,
        ns=None,
        is_ordered=False,
        log_scale_params=False,
    )


def gradient_analytical(log_params: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Analytical gradient in log-parameter space."""
    params = np.exp(log_params)
    return np.multiply(
        params,
        -log_likelihood_gradient(
            params=params,
            ages=benchmark_ages,
            observation_time=benchmark_time,
            spine_ages=None,
            ns=None,
            is_ordered=False,
            log_scale_params=False,
        ),
    )


print("✅ Optimization strategies defined")

# Verify gradient and objective at initial point
print("\n🔍 PRE-BENCHMARK DIAGNOSTICS")
print("=" * 60)
initial_obj = objective_analytical(benchmark_log_initial)
initial_grad = gradient_analytical(benchmark_log_initial)
print(f"Initial log-params: {benchmark_log_initial}")
print(
    f"Initial params (original): birth={np.exp(benchmark_log_initial[0]):.6f}, death={np.exp(benchmark_log_initial[1]):.6f}"
)
print(f"Initial objective value: {initial_obj:.6f}")
print(f"Initial gradient: [{initial_grad[0]:.6e}, {initial_grad[1]:.6e}]")
print(f"Gradient norm: {np.linalg.norm(initial_grad):.6e}")

# Test a small step in the gradient direction
step_size = 0.01
test_point = benchmark_log_initial - step_size * initial_grad
test_obj = objective_analytical(test_point)
print(f"\nTest point (small step opposite to gradient):")
print(f"  log-params: {test_point}")
print(f"  Objective: {test_obj:.6f}")
print(f"  Objective change: {test_obj - initial_obj:.6e} (should be negative)")

# Check gradient with finite differences
epsilon = 1e-7
grad_numerical = optimize.approx_fprime(
    benchmark_log_initial, objective_analytical, epsilon
)
print(f"\nGradient verification:")
print(f"  Analytical: [{initial_grad[0]:.6e}, {initial_grad[1]:.6e}]")
print(f"  Numerical:  [{grad_numerical[0]:.6e}, {grad_numerical[1]:.6e}]")
print(
    f"  Difference: [{abs(initial_grad[0]-grad_numerical[0]):.6e}, {abs(initial_grad[1]-grad_numerical[1]):.6e}]"
)
print("=" * 60)
```

## Benchmark Individual Methods

```{python}
# | label: benchmark-methods

optimization_methods = [
    {
        "name": "BFGS (Analytical)",
        "method": "BFGS",
        "jac": gradient_analytical,
        "bounds": None,
        "options": {"maxiter": 1000},
    },
    {
        "name": "BFGS (Numerical)",
        "method": "BFGS",
        "jac": None,
        "bounds": None,
        "options": {"maxiter": 1000},
    },
    {
        "name": "L-BFGS-B (Analytical)",
        "method": "L-BFGS-B",
        "jac": gradient_analytical,
        "bounds": log_bounds,
        "options": {"maxiter": 1000, "ftol": 1e-12, "gtol": 1e-8},
    },
    {
        "name": "L-BFGS-B (Numerical)",
        "method": "L-BFGS-B",
        "jac": None,
        "bounds": log_bounds,
        "options": {"maxiter": 1000, "ftol": 1e-12, "gtol": 1e-8},
    },
    {
        "name": "Powell",
        "method": "Powell",
        "jac": None,
        "bounds": None,
        "options": {"maxiter": 1000, "ftol": 1e-9},
    },
    {
        "name": "Nelder-Mead",
        "method": "Nelder-Mead",
        "jac": None,
        "bounds": None,
        "options": {"maxiter": 1000, "ftol": 1e-9},
    },
    {
        "name": "Newton-CG (Analytical)",
        "method": "Newton-CG",
        "jac": gradient_analytical,
        "bounds": None,
        "options": {"maxiter": 1000},
    },
]

benchmark_results = []

print("\n🔬 Running optimization benchmarks...")
print("=" * 60)

for config in optimization_methods:
    print(f"\n▶ Testing: {config['name']}")

    timings = []
    results_list = []
    n_runs = 10  # Number of runs for averaging

    for run in range(n_runs):
        try:
            start_time = time.perf_counter()

            # Debug: Check objective and gradient at initial point
            if run == 0:
                initial_obj = objective_analytical(benchmark_log_initial)
                initial_grad = (
                    gradient_analytical(benchmark_log_initial)
                    if config["jac"] is not None
                    else None
                )
                print(f"  📍 Initial point: log_params = {benchmark_log_initial}")
                print(f"  📍 Initial objective: {initial_obj:.6f}")
                if initial_grad is not None:
                    print(
                        f"  📍 Initial gradient: [{initial_grad[0]:.6e}, {initial_grad[1]:.6e}]"
                    )
                    print(f"  📍 Gradient norm: {np.linalg.norm(initial_grad):.6e}")

            result = optimize.minimize(
                objective_analytical,
                x0=benchmark_log_initial,
                method=config["method"],
                jac=config["jac"],
                bounds=config["bounds"],
                options=config["options"],
            )

            # Debug: Check if parameters actually changed
            if run == 0:
                param_change = np.linalg.norm(result.x - benchmark_log_initial)
                print(f"  📍 Final point: log_params = {result.x}")
                print(f"  📍 Final objective: {result.fun:.6f}")
                print(f"  📍 Parameter change (L2 norm): {param_change:.6e}")
                print(
                    f"  📍 Max param change: {np.max(np.abs(result.x - benchmark_log_initial)):.6e}"
                )

            end_time = time.perf_counter()
            elapsed = end_time - start_time

            timings.append(elapsed)
            results_list.append(result)

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  ❌ Error on run {run + 1}: {str(e)}")
            continue

    if len(results_list) > 0:
        # Use the best result (lowest function value)
        best_idx = np.argmin([r.fun for r in results_list])
        best_result = results_list[best_idx]

        birth_rate = np.exp(best_result.x[0])
        death_rate = np.exp(best_result.x[1])

        benchmark_results.append(
            {
                "Method": config["name"],
                "Success": best_result.success,
                "Mean Time (s)": np.mean(timings),
                "Std Time (s)": np.std(timings),
                "Min Time (s)": np.min(timings),
                "Max Time (s)": np.max(timings),
                "Birth Rate": birth_rate,
                "Death Rate": death_rate,
                "Log Likelihood": -best_result.fun,
                "N Function Evals": (
                    best_result.nfev if hasattr(best_result, "nfev") else np.nan
                ),
                "N Iterations": (
                    best_result.nit if hasattr(best_result, "nit") else np.nan
                ),
                "N Jacobian Evals": (
                    best_result.njev if hasattr(best_result, "njev") else np.nan
                ),
            }
        )

        print(f"  ✅ Success: {best_result.success}")
        print(
            f"  ⏱️  Mean time: {np.mean(timings)*1000:.2f} ms (±{np.std(timings)*1000:.2f} ms)"
        )
        print(f"  📊 λ̂: {birth_rate:.6f}, μ̂: {death_rate:.6f}")
        print(f"  📈 Log-likelihood: {-best_result.fun:.4f}")
        if hasattr(best_result, "nfev"):
            print(f"  🔢 Function evaluations: {best_result.nfev}")
    else:
        print(f"  ❌ All runs failed for {config['name']}")

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("✅ Benchmark completed")
```

## Efficiency Metrics

```{python}
# | label: benchmark-efficiency

print("\n⚡ EFFICIENCY ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 80)

if len(successful_methods) > 0:
    # Calculate efficiency score (higher log-likelihood per unit time)
    successful_methods_copy = successful_methods.copy()
    successful_methods_copy["Efficiency Score"] = (
        successful_methods_copy["Log Likelihood"]
        / successful_methods_copy["Mean Time (s)"]
    )

    successful_methods_copy = successful_methods_copy.sort_values(
        "Efficiency Score", ascending=False
    )

    print("\n🏆 Methods ranked by efficiency (log-likelihood per second):")
    print("-" * 80)
    for idx, row in successful_methods_copy.iterrows():
        print(
            f"{row['Method']:30s} {row['Efficiency Score']:12.2f}  "
            f"(LL: {row['Log Likelihood']:.4f}, Time: {row['Mean Time (s)']*1000:.2f} ms)"
        )

    # Identify Pareto-optimal methods
    print("\n\n💡 RECOMMENDATIONS:")
    print("-" * 80)

    fastest = successful_methods_copy.iloc[
        successful_methods_copy["Mean Time (s)"].argmin()
    ]
    best_likelihood = successful_methods_copy.iloc[
        successful_methods_copy["Log Likelihood"].argmax()
    ]
    most_efficient = successful_methods_copy.iloc[0]  # Already sorted by efficiency

    print(f"\n⚡ Fastest Method:")
    print(f"   {fastest['Method']}: {fastest['Mean Time (s)']*1000:.2f} ms")

    print(f"\n🎯 Best Log-Likelihood:")
    print(f"   {best_likelihood['Method']}: {best_likelihood['Log Likelihood']:.6f}")

    print(f"\n⭐ Most Efficient (Best Trade-off):")
    print(
        f"   {most_efficient['Method']}: Score {most_efficient['Efficiency Score']:.2f}"
    )

    # Compare analytical vs numerical gradients for BFGS
    bfgs_analytical = benchmark_df[benchmark_df["Method"] == "BFGS (Analytical)"]
    bfgs_numerical = benchmark_df[benchmark_df["Method"] == "BFGS (Numerical)"]

    if len(bfgs_analytical) > 0 and len(bfgs_numerical) > 0:
        print(f"\n\n📊 Analytical vs Numerical Gradients (BFGS):")
        print("-" * 80)

        time_analytical = bfgs_analytical.iloc[0]["Mean Time (s)"] * 1000
        time_numerical = bfgs_numerical.iloc[0]["Mean Time (s)"] * 1000
        speedup = time_numerical / time_analytical

        print(f"   Analytical: {time_analytical:.2f} ms")
        print(f"   Numerical:  {time_numerical:.2f} ms")
        print(f"   Speedup:    {speedup:.2f}x {'faster' if speedup > 1 else 'slower'}")

        if bfgs_analytical.iloc[0]["Success"] and bfgs_numerical.iloc[0]["Success"]:
            print(
                f"\n   Analytical grad evaluations: {bfgs_analytical.iloc[0]['N Jacobian Evals']:.0f}"
            )
            print(
                f"   Numerical grad evaluations:  {bfgs_numerical.iloc[0]['N Jacobian Evals']:.0f}"
            )

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
```

## Gradient Verification

```{python}
# | label: gradient-verification

print("\n🔍 GRADIENT VERIFICATION")
print("=" * 80)

# Test point
test_log_params = benchmark_log_initial

# Analytical gradient
grad_analytical = gradient_analytical(test_log_params)

# Numerical gradient using scipy.optimize.approx_fprime
epsilon = 1e-7
grad_numerical = optimize.approx_fprime(test_log_params, objective_analytical, epsilon)

# Compare
print(f"\nGradient at test point (log-params = {test_log_params}):")
print(f"  Analytical:  [{grad_analytical[0]:.8f}, {grad_analytical[1]:.8f}]")
print(f"  Numerical:   [{grad_numerical[0]:.8f}, {grad_numerical[1]:.8f}]")
print(
    f"  Difference:  [{grad_analytical[0]-grad_numerical[0]:.2e}, {grad_analytical[1]-grad_numerical[1]:.2e}]"
)

max_diff = np.max(np.abs(grad_analytical - grad_numerical))
relative_diff = max_diff / np.max(np.abs(grad_analytical))

print(f"\n  Max absolute difference: {max_diff:.2e}")
print(f"  Max relative difference: {relative_diff:.2e}")

if relative_diff < 1e-5:
    print("  ✅ Gradients match closely!")
elif relative_diff < 1e-3:
    print("  ⚠️  Gradients differ slightly (acceptable for finite differences)")
else:
    print("  ❌ Significant gradient mismatch - check implementation!")

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
```
